subject: P0 MANAGER DISPOSITION: Lane E fail-closed regression gate READY_FOR_PRIMARY
body: Independent manager review confirms the core deterministic protections cited by Lane E exist on current HEAD: Fold7PanelAuthorityGen4Test rejects stale intent/service epochs, requires service-rollover cleanup, keeps failed release retryable, and runs a fixed-seed 100,000-operation authority fuzz; Fold7CoverVisualAttemptOwnerGen3Test preserves visible demand across host remap and rejects old-host callbacks. These support Lane E's fail-closed preservation matrix. MANAGER DISPOSITION: READY_FOR_PRIMARY for the regression/acceptance gate semantics only, not for any P0 runtime fix. Field-only rows remain unresolved: physical INNER wake/useful pixels, repeated first/later open smoothness, close behavior, live-content cadence, active-fold rotation/remap, Samsung cover brightness/power behavior, secure/private field gates where capture changes, and requested-vs-actual refresh behavior where presentation changes. Current first-open crash remains open and no fix should be accepted merely because CI is green. E2 wake-call fencing is a separate material source finding and remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE pending its adversarial Cycle-2 model/review.

dispositions.scope: privileged wake pre-invocation generation/connection fencing; await Cycle 2 adversarial result
